where: Warning #1 — the app rewards reviews with cosmetic unlocks and reviewers say so: 'I'm just doing this to get the backgrounds 😋 I haven't even used the app at all'

Reviews with a body of ≤25 characters rose from 20.9% of 2021–22 (87/416) and 16.5% of 2023 (90/547) to 35.0% of 2024 (532/1,521), 35.7% of 2025 (369/1,034) and 32.3% of 2026 (103/319), and 83–91% of them are 5★ in every era; every aggregate is restated for substantive reviews (>60 chars, n=1,791)
